subject: general
question: Which of the following terms is not used in lawn tennis?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Scoop**__. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Terms used in lawn tennis:
 
 
• Volley,
 
• **Smash,**
 
• **Ace**,
 
• Service,
 
• Backhand drive,
 
• Advantage,
 
• **Deuce**,
 
• Double Fault.
 
 
 
• **Hence Scoop is not used in lawn tennis.**
